data.title: Advisory on use of version 3.3 of emSigner
data.content:
This is an advance information to the all users – Taxpayers and Tax Officers, of GST System who use Digital Certificate Signature on the GST Portal.

A new version of emSigner (v3.3) is being made available for download for the purpose of providing compatibility with tokens (USB dongles) that are issued on or after 21-September-2026.

data.title: Enabling Filing of Appeals in Cases Involving NIL or Zero Demand Amount – reg.
data.content: In cases where a dispute regarding liability exists but the demand amount is reflected as "NIL" or "Zero" in the demand order, and payment has been made by the taxpayer prior to the issuance of the demand order, the previous validation restricting the filing of an appeal against such demand orders has been removed from the GST Portal.

data.title: Advisory on Keeping on Hold the Proposed e-Way Bill Enhancements
data.content:
GSTN had earlier issued advisories dated 9th June 2026 and 17th June 2026 regarding certain proposed enhancements to the e-Way Bill system, with the scheduled date of implementation as 1st August 2026. Detailed FAQs relating to these enhancements were also issued on 2nd July 2026.

It is hereby informed that the implementation of the above-mentioned enhancements has been kept on hold until further notice

All related advisories, along with the FAQs issued, shall also be withdrawn from the GST Portal.

Thanks,
Team GSTN

data.title: Advisory on Revision of Timeline for Amendment of Aggregate Annual Turnover (AATO), 2026
data.content: It is informed that the Aggregate Annual Turnover (AATO) functionality is currently being upgraded to enable automatic updation of AATO as subsequent returns are filed post amendment window.
